q21223.en: The sign shown is a motorway confirmation sign.

explain.short: It is green and lists towns with their distances: this is the confirmation sign used on motorways.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'di conferma' (confirmation): it confirms the direction you are already following.

sceneParams.caption: Green confirmation sign: motorway

q21224.en: The sign shown lists places with their distances in kilometres.

explain.short: Each line has a town and a number; the number is the distance in km to that town.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'relative distanze' (their distances): each number belongs to the town on its line.

sceneParams.caption: Each town with its km to go

q21225.en: The sign shown, if blue, is found on extraurban roads.

explain.short: The same confirmation sign also exists in blue, and blue is the colour of extraurban roads (main roads outside towns).
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'se di colore blu' (if blue): the colour tells the road type, green = motorway, blue = outside towns.

sceneParams.caption: Blue version = extraurban road

q21226.en: The sign shown is placed on a motorway.

explain.short: A green background means motorway: this confirmation sign stands on the motorway.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'autostrada' (motorway): the green colour tells you so.

sceneParams.caption: Green = on the motorway

q21227.en: The sign shown indicates that there are 180 kilometres to go to Florence.

explain.short: The number next to Firenze is 180: that is the distance you still have to drive to Florence.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'mancano' (are left / to go): the km are still ahead of you, not already done.

sceneParams.caption: 180 km still to go to Firenze

q21228.en: The sign shown indicates, on the motorway, the distance of the places you can reach.

explain.short: On the motorway it shows towns you can reach along this road and how far away they are.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'raggiungibili' (that can be reached): the towns are ahead on this route.

sceneParams.caption: Towns ahead and their distance

q21229.en: The sign shown indicates that by leaving at the first motorway toll gate you can reach all the places shown.

explain.short: The sign only gives distances along the motorway; it does not say that one exit leads to all these towns.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'primo casello' (first toll gate): the sign says nothing about exits.

sceneParams.caption: Only km along the motorway, no exit info

q21230.en: The sign shown indicates that to reach Milan you must take motorway number 472.

explain.short: 472 is the distance in km to Milan, not the number of a motorway.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'autostrada n. 472' (motorway no. 472): the number is km, not a road number.

sceneParams.caption: 472 = km to Milano, not a road number

q21231.en: The sign shown indicates that there are 180 kilometres to go to the Florence service area.

explain.short: 180 km is the distance to the town of Florence, not to a service area (a motorway stop with fuel and café).
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'area di servizio' (service area): the sign names towns, not service areas.

sceneParams.caption: 180 km to the town, not to a service area

q21232.en: The sign shown indicates, for each place, the number of the road to take.

explain.short: The numbers next to the towns are distances in km, not road numbers.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'numero della strada' (road number): road numbers have their own small panels, like 'E 55' or 'SS 2'.

sceneParams.caption: Numbers are km, not road numbers

q21233.en: The sign shown indicates the kilometres already travelled from the places shown.

explain.short: The numbers show the km still to go to those towns, not the km already driven.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'già fatti' (already done): the km are ahead of you.

sceneParams.caption: Km still ahead, not already driven

q21234.en: The sign shown is placed on extraurban roads.

explain.short: This sign is green, so it stands on a motorway. On extraurban roads the same sign would be blue.
explain.rule: A GREEN 'segnale di conferma' (confirmation sign) stands on the motorway: it lists towns ahead and the km still to go to each. On extraurban roads the same sign is blue.
explain.trap: 'strade extraurbane' (extraurban roads): only the BLUE version is used there.

sceneParams.caption: Green = motorway; blue would be extraurban

q21235.en: The sign shown indicates an international road route.

explain.short: The letter E with a number marks a European route, a road that crosses several countries.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'itinerario internazionale' (international route): E stands for Europe.

sceneParams.caption: E 55 = international route

q21236.en: The sign shown indicates the international classification number of the road.

explain.short: 55 is the number this road has in the international (European) list of roads.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'classificazione internazionale' (international classification): 55 is a road number, not km.

sceneParams.caption: 55 = the road's international number

q21237.en: The sign shown is placed on roads of international importance.

explain.short: E routes link different countries, so this sign stands on roads of international importance.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'importanza internazionale' (international importance): the E shows it.

sceneParams.caption: On roads that link countries

q21238.en: The sign shown indicates international route no. 55.

explain.short: The panel reads E 55: European international route number 55.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'n. 55' (no. 55): the number is the route's name.

sceneParams.caption: International route number 55

q21239.en: The sign shown can be found inside an advance road-junction sign.

explain.short: Route-number panels are often put inside bigger direction signs, such as the sign that announces a fork ahead.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'all'interno' (inside): the small panel can be part of a bigger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Can be part of a bigger junction sign

keywords.en: advance warning of a fork / junction

q21240.en: The sign shown identifies extraurban roads.

explain.short: It does not mark extraurban roads in general: it marks one European international route, E 55.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'strade extraurbane' (roads outside towns): this panel names an international route, not a road type.

sceneParams.caption: Marks an E route, not extraurban roads

q21241.en: The sign shown indicates motorway exit no. 55.

explain.short: 55 is the number of the international route, not of a motorway exit.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'uscita autostradale' (motorway exit): the E means a European route, not an exit.

sceneParams.caption: E 55 is a route, not exit 55

q21242.en: The sign shown indicates that there are 55 kilometres to go to the national border.

explain.short: The number is the route's name, not a distance to the border.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'confine di Stato' (national border): the sign gives no distance at all.

sceneParams.caption: 55 is a route number, not km to a border

q21243.en: The sign shown indicates the maximum speed to keep on that road.

explain.short: Speed limits are shown in a red circle. This green panel is only the route's number.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'velocità massima' (maximum speed): no red ring, so no speed limit.

sceneParams.caption: Not a speed limit: just a route number

q21244.en: The sign shown indicates the number of the overpass.

explain.short: It numbers a European road route, not a bridge or overpass.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'cavalcavia' (overpass, a bridge over the road): not shown on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: A route number, not an overpass number

q21245.en: The sign shown indicates that 55 kilometres have been travelled from the starting point of the motorway.

explain.short: 55 is not a distance: it is the number of the international route.
explain.rule: A green panel with 'E' and a number marks a European international route: E 55 is international route number 55.
explain.trap: 'sono stati percorsi' (have been travelled): this is a route name, not a km count.

sceneParams.caption: 55 = route number, not km travelled

q21246.en: The sign shown indicates the type and number of the road you are travelling on.

explain.short: SS is the type of road (state road) and 2 is its number.
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'tipo ed il numero' (type and number): the letters are the type, the figure is the number.

sceneParams.caption: SS = type, 2 = number

q21247.en: The sign shown can be found inside a direction sign or a road-junction sign.

explain.short: Road-number panels are often put inside bigger direction or junction signs.
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'all'interno' (inside): the small panel can be part of a larger sign.

sceneParams.caption: Can be part of a direction sign

q21248.en: The sign shown indicates that the road we are travelling on is a state road.

explain.short: SS stands for 'strada statale' (state road).
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'strada statale' (state road): SS is its short form.

sceneParams.caption: SS = strada statale

q21249.en: The sign shown indicates that we are travelling on state road no. 2.

explain.short: The panel reads SS 2: state road number 2.
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'n. 2' (no. 2): the number is the road's name, not km.

sceneParams.caption: State road number 2

q21250.en: The sign shown indicates the number of lay-bys.

explain.short: 2 is the road number, not a count of lay-bys (small stopping places at the roadside).
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'piazzole di sosta' (lay-bys): they are not on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: 2 is the road number, not lay-bys

q21251.en: The sign shown indicates a slippery road for 2 kilometres.

explain.short: A slippery road is shown by a red triangle danger sign. Here 2 is just the road number.
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'sdrucciolevole' (slippery): danger signs are red triangles, not blue panels.

sceneParams.caption: Not a danger sign: SS 2 is a road

q21252.en: The sign shown indicates a narrow road for 2 kilometres.

explain.short: A narrowing is shown by a red triangle danger sign. Here 2 is just the road number.
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'strada stretta' (narrow road): danger signs are red triangles, not blue panels.

sceneParams.caption: Not a narrowing: SS 2 is a road

q21253.en: The sign shown indicates a dead-end road in 2 kilometres.

explain.short: A dead end has its own sign. Here 2 is the number of the state road.
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'senza uscita' (dead end, no way out): SS 2 says nothing about that.

sceneParams.caption: Not a dead end: SS 2 is a road

q21254.en: The sign shown indicates a road without signs or markings for 2 kilometres.

explain.short: The panel only gives the road's type and number; 2 is not a distance.
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'senza segnaletica' (without signs or markings): not what SS 2 means.

sceneParams.caption: SS 2 = state road 2, nothing else

q21255.en: The sign shown indicates a dirt (unpaved) road.

explain.short: SS means 'strada statale' (state road), an important road, not an unpaved track.
explain.rule: A blue panel with 'SS' and a number gives the road type and number: SS 2 = 'strada statale' (state road) number 2.
explain.trap: 'sterrata' (unpaved, dirt road): SS does not mean that.

sceneParams.caption: SS = state road, not a dirt road

q21256.en: The sign shown can be found at the start of a municipal road.

explain.short: It names municipal road no. 19, so it can stand where that road begins.
explain.rule: A white panel with 'SC' and a number marks a 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC 19 = municipal road number 19.
explain.trap: 'si può trovare' (can be found): a possible place for it, and a correct one.

sceneParams.caption: At the start of municipal road 19

q21257.en: The sign shown can be found completing direction signs.

explain.short: Road-number panels are added to direction signs to show which road leads to a place.
explain.rule: A white panel with 'SC' and a number marks a 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC 19 = municipal road number 19.
explain.trap: 'a completamento' (as an addition): it adds information to direction signs.

sceneParams.caption: Added to direction signs

q21258.en: The sign shown identifies a municipal road.

explain.short: SC stands for 'strada comunale' (municipal road).
explain.rule: A white panel with 'SC' and a number marks a 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC 19 = municipal road number 19.
explain.trap: 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC is its short form.

sceneParams.caption: SC = strada comunale

q21259.en: The sign shown can be found along municipal road no. 19.

explain.short: SC 19 names municipal road number 19, so it can stand along that road.
explain.rule: A white panel with 'SC' and a number marks a 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC 19 = municipal road number 19.
explain.trap: 'lungo' (along): the panel can be repeated on the road.

sceneParams.caption: Along municipal road 19

q21260.en: The sign shown is located nineteen kilometres from the nearest Carabinieri station.

explain.short: 19 is the road number, not a distance to the Carabinieri (a police force).
explain.rule: A white panel with 'SC' and a number marks a 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC 19 = municipal road number 19.
explain.trap: 'diciannove chilometri' (nineteen kilometres): the number is not km.

sceneParams.caption: 19 is a road number, not km

q21261.en: The sign shown is located at the start of a country road.

explain.short: SC means 'strada comunale' (municipal road), not 'strada di campagna' (country road).
explain.rule: A white panel with 'SC' and a number marks a 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC 19 = municipal road number 19.
explain.trap: 'strada di campagna' (country road): the C stands for 'comunale'.

sceneParams.caption: SC = municipal, not country road

q21262.en: The sign shown is located where the road can be used only with snow chains.

explain.short: Compulsory snow chains have their own round blue sign. This panel only names municipal road 19.
explain.rule: A white panel with 'SC' and a number marks a 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC 19 = municipal road number 19.
explain.trap: 'catene da neve' (snow chains): nothing on this sign is about snow.

sceneParams.caption: Names a road; nothing about snow chains

q21263.en: The sign shown is located on roads where parking is allowed after 7 pm (19:00).

explain.short: 19 is the road number, not a time of day.
explain.rule: A white panel with 'SC' and a number marks a 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC 19 = municipal road number 19.
explain.trap: 'dopo le ore 19.00' (after 7 pm): the number is not a time.

sceneParams.caption: 19 is a road number, not a time

q21264.en: The sign shown indicates, on an urban road, the number of the overpass.

explain.short: It numbers a municipal road, not an overpass (a bridge over the road).
explain.rule: A white panel with 'SC' and a number marks a 'strada comunale' (municipal road): SC 19 = municipal road number 19.
explain.trap: 'cavalcavia' (overpass): this panel names a road, not a bridge.

sceneParams.caption: A road number, not an overpass number

q21265.en: The sign shown indicates that a camping area is nearby.

explain.short: The tent and caravan pictures announce a campsite close by.
explain.rule: A tent and a caravan on the sign announce a nearby camping area, where you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.trap: 'vicinanza' (nearness): the camping area is close.

sceneParams.caption: Campsite nearby

q21266.en: The sign shown indicates a camping area with tents and parking for caravans and motorhomes.

explain.short: The tent means camping and the caravan means parking for caravans and motorhomes.
explain.rule: A tent and a caravan on the sign announce a nearby camping area, where you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.trap: 'autocaravan' (motorhome, camper van): it is included in the area.

sceneParams.caption: Tents plus caravan and motorhome parking

q21267.en: The sign shown indicates a zone meant for parking caravans and motorhomes and for camping.

explain.short: It shows an area set aside for caravans, motorhomes and camping.
explain.rule: A tent and a caravan on the sign announce a nearby camping area, where you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.trap: 'zona destinata' (zone meant for): the area has this purpose.

sceneParams.caption: Area for caravans, motorhomes and camping

q21268.en: The sign shown indicates that camping and parking of caravans and motorhomes are allowed.

explain.short: In the area shown, you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.rule: A tent and a caravan on the sign announce a nearby camping area, where you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.trap: 'è consentito' (is allowed): it is a permission, not a ban.

sceneParams.caption: Camping and caravan parking allowed

q21269.en: The sign shown indicates a parking ban for caravans and camping vehicles.

explain.short: It is the opposite: it shows a place where caravans may park and people may camp.
explain.rule: A tent and a caravan on the sign announce a nearby camping area, where you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.trap: 'divieto' (ban): bans are red circles; this is an information sign.

sceneParams.caption: Not a ban: caravans may park here

q21270.en: The sign shown indicates a scenic area.

explain.short: The tent and caravan mean camping, not a viewpoint.
explain.rule: A tent and a caravan on the sign announce a nearby camping area, where you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.trap: 'zona panoramica' (scenic area, a place with a nice view): the symbols show camping.

sceneParams.caption: Camping area, not a viewpoint

q21271.en: The sign shown indicates a repair workshop for camping vehicles nearby.

explain.short: The sign shows camping, not a place that repairs vehicles.
explain.rule: A tent and a caravan on the sign announce a nearby camping area, where you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.trap: 'officina di riparazione' (repair workshop): there are no tools on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Camping area, not a workshop

q21272.en: The sign shown indicates a mobile police post nearby.

explain.short: A tent and a caravan mean camping, not police.
explain.rule: A tent and a caravan on the sign announce a nearby camping area, where you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.trap: 'postazione mobile di Polizia' (mobile police post): nothing about police on this sign.

sceneParams.caption: Camping area, not police

q21273.en: The sign shown indicates a mobile first-aid post nearby.

explain.short: A tent and a caravan mean camping, not first aid.
explain.rule: A tent and a caravan on the sign announce a nearby camping area, where you may camp and park caravans and motorhomes.
explain.trap: 'pronto soccorso' (first aid): first aid has a different symbol.

sceneParams.caption: Camping area, not first aid

q21274.en: The sign shown indicates the address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police command.

explain.short: The panel has lines for town, address and phones of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.rule: The 'POLIZIA STRADALE' panel gives the town, address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.trap: 'più vicino' (nearest): it is the closest traffic police office.

sceneParams.caption: Address and phones of the traffic police

q21275.en: The sign shown indicates the town and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police command.

explain.short: The panel has a 'località' (town) line and a 'telefoni' (phones) line for the nearest traffic police office.
explain.rule: The 'POLIZIA STRADALE' panel gives the town, address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.trap: 'località' (place, town): it is written on the panel.

sceneParams.caption: Town and phones of the traffic police

q21276.en: The sign shown indicates the location and phone number of the nearest traffic police command.

explain.short: It tells you where the nearest traffic police office is and how to phone it.
explain.rule: The 'POLIZIA STRADALE' panel gives the town, address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.trap: 'sede' (office, where it is based): town and address on the panel give it.

sceneParams.caption: Where the police office is, and its phone

q21277.en: The sign shown gives some details (town, street, phones) of the nearest traffic police command.

explain.short: Town, address (street) and phone numbers are exactly the three lines on the panel.
explain.rule: The 'POLIZIA STRADALE' panel gives the town, address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.trap: 'alcuni dati' (some details): only these few details, nothing else.

sceneParams.caption: Town, street, phones of the traffic police

q21278.en: The sign shown indicates a police roadblock.

explain.short: It only gives the address and phones of a police office; it does not announce a checkpoint.
explain.rule: The 'POLIZIA STRADALE' panel gives the town, address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.trap: 'posto di blocco' (roadblock, checkpoint): nothing on the panel says so.

sceneParams.caption: Info panel, not a roadblock

q21279.en: The sign shown indicates a road closed because of a road accident.

explain.short: The panel gives police contact details; it says nothing about accidents or closed roads.
explain.rule: The 'POLIZIA STRADALE' panel gives the town, address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.trap: 'strada interrotta' (closed road): not written anywhere on the panel.

sceneParams.caption: Info panel, not a closed road

q21280.en: The sign shown indicates a zone reserved for parking police vehicles.

explain.short: The panel gives the address and phones of a police office, not a parking area.
explain.rule: The 'POLIZIA STRADALE' panel gives the town, address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.trap: 'riservata al parcheggio' (reserved for parking): there is no parking symbol.

sceneParams.caption: Info panel, not police parking

q21281.en: The sign shown indicates that you may meet a convoy of police vehicles.

explain.short: The panel only gives police contact details; it warns of nothing on the road.
explain.rule: The 'POLIZIA STRADALE' panel gives the town, address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.trap: 'colonna' (convoy, line of vehicles): the panel says nothing about it.

sceneParams.caption: Info panel, not a police convoy

q21282.en: The sign shown indicates a stretch of road reserved for the police.

explain.short: The panel gives police contact details; it does not reserve the road for anyone.
explain.rule: The 'POLIZIA STRADALE' panel gives the town, address and phone numbers of the nearest traffic police office.
explain.trap: 'riservato' (reserved): no reserved road is shown.

sceneParams.caption: Info panel, not a police-only road

q21283.en: The sign shown indicates a one-way road straight ahead ('frontal' one-way).

explain.short: The blue square with an arrow up tells you the road in front of you is one-way, in your direction.
explain.rule: The blue square with an up arrow ('senso unico frontale') says the road ahead is one-way in your direction. Because it is one-way, U-turns are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'frontale' (in front): the one-way road is the one straight ahead.

sceneParams.caption: Road ahead is one-way

q21284.en: The sign shown indicates that traffic on that stretch of road is one-way.

explain.short: On that stretch all vehicles travel in the same direction, the direction of the arrow.
explain.rule: The blue square with an up arrow ('senso unico frontale') says the road ahead is one-way in your direction. Because it is one-way, U-turns are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'senso unico' (one-way): only one direction of travel.

sceneParams.caption: All traffic goes one way

q21285.en: The sign shown indicates that after it a U-turn is forbidden.

explain.short: On a one-way road, turning around would put you against the traffic, so U-turns are forbidden.
explain.rule: The blue square with an up arrow ('senso unico frontale') says the road ahead is one-way in your direction. Because it is one-way, U-turns are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'inversione di marcia' (U-turn): not drawn on the sign, but it follows from one-way.

sceneParams.caption: One-way: no U-turn after the sign

q21286.en: The sign shown indicates the start of a one-way road.

explain.short: It is placed where the one-way road begins.
explain.rule: The blue square with an up arrow ('senso unico frontale') says the road ahead is one-way in your direction. Because it is one-way, U-turns are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'inizio' (start): the sign stands at the beginning of the one-way road.

sceneParams.caption: Start of a one-way road

q21287.en: The sign shown indicates the obligation to go straight on.

explain.short: It only informs you that the road is one-way. Compulsory straight ahead is a ROUND blue sign.
explain.rule: The blue square with an up arrow ('senso unico frontale') says the road ahead is one-way in your direction. Because it is one-way, U-turns are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'obbligo' (obligation): a square sign informs, a round blue sign gives orders.

sceneParams.caption: Square = information, not an order

q21288.en: The sign shown indicates a ban on turning right or left.

explain.short: It only says the road ahead is one-way; it does not forbid turning where turns are allowed.
explain.rule: The blue square with an up arrow ('senso unico frontale') says the road ahead is one-way in your direction. Because it is one-way, U-turns are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'divieto' (ban): this blue square bans no turn.

sceneParams.caption: One-way ahead; turns are not banned

q21289.en: The sign shown indicates that you must drive in only one lane.

explain.short: One-way does not mean one lane: a one-way road can have several lanes.
explain.rule: The blue square with an up arrow ('senso unico frontale') says the road ahead is one-way in your direction. Because it is one-way, U-turns are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'una sola corsia' (only one lane): one-way is about direction, not lanes.

sceneParams.caption: One direction, not one lane

q21290.en: The sign shown indicates a narrowing of the carriageway.

explain.short: A narrowing is shown by a red triangle danger sign. This blue square means one-way.
explain.rule: The blue square with an up arrow ('senso unico frontale') says the road ahead is one-way in your direction. Because it is one-way, U-turns are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'restringimento' (narrowing): danger signs are triangles, not blue squares.

sceneParams.caption: One-way sign, not a narrowing

q21291.en: The sign shown indicates that traffic moves in parallel rows.

explain.short: Parallel rows happen in heavy traffic on roads with several lanes; this sign only says the road is one-way.
explain.rule: The blue square with an up arrow ('senso unico frontale') says the road ahead is one-way in your direction. Because it is one-way, U-turns are forbidden.
explain.trap: 'file parallele' (parallel rows of vehicles): not what the arrow means.

sceneParams.caption: One-way, not parallel rows

q21292.en: The sign shown indicates that the road it is placed on is one-way.

explain.short: The sign stands on the road it describes: that road runs one way only, in the arrow's direction.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'su cui è posto' (on which it is placed): the sign belongs to that road.

sceneParams.caption: This road is one-way, arrow's direction

q21293.en: Sign A in the picture indicates that, turning left, the road is one-way.

explain.short: Sign A points left: the road to the left is one-way in that direction.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'svoltando a sinistra' (turning left): A's arrow points left.

sceneParams.caption: Turn left: one-way road

q21294.en: The sign shown indicates that, turning in the arrow's direction, you do not meet vehicles coming from the opposite direction.

explain.short: The road is one-way in the arrow's direction, so nobody comes towards you.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'senso opposto' (opposite direction): on a one-way road there is none.

sceneParams.caption: No oncoming traffic after the turn

q21295.en: The sign shown indicates that, once you have turned in the arrow's direction, a U-turn is forbidden.

explain.short: On a one-way road, turning around would put you against the traffic, so U-turns are forbidden.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'inversione di marcia' (U-turn): not drawn, but it follows from one-way.

sceneParams.caption: One-way: no U-turn after turning

q21296.en: The sign shown indicates that on the stretch of road where it is placed you must overtake on the right.

explain.short: The sign only gives the one-way direction; it never orders you to overtake on the right.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'si deve' (you must): no sign makes overtaking on the right compulsory.

sceneParams.caption: Shows one-way, says nothing on overtaking

q21297.en: Sign A in the picture indicates that it is compulsory to turn left.

explain.short: Sign A only tells you the road to the left is one-way; you are not forced to turn there.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'obbligatorio' (compulsory): compulsory turns use ROUND blue signs.

sceneParams.caption: Info only: you may turn left, not must

q21298.en: The sign shown indicates that going straight on is forbidden.

explain.short: It only tells you the side road is one-way; it does not forbid going straight on.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'è vietato' (is forbidden): this blue sign forbids nothing.

sceneParams.caption: Info only: straight on is not banned

q21299.en: The sign shown indicates that you must drive in parallel rows.

explain.short: The sign only shows a one-way direction; it says nothing about rows of traffic.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'file parallele' (parallel rows of vehicles): not what the arrow means.

sceneParams.caption: One-way, not parallel rows

q21300.en: The sign shown indicates that, turning in the arrow's direction, parking is allowed only on the left.

explain.short: The sign says nothing about parking. On one-way roads you may usually stop on both sides, unless a sign forbids it.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'solo a sinistra' (only on the left): 'solo' is the trap word.

sceneParams.caption: Says nothing about parking sides

q21301.en: The sign shown indicates a free car park in the arrow's direction.

explain.short: The arrow shows a one-way direction, not the way to a car park.
explain.rule: The blue rectangle with an arrow ('senso unico parallelo') says the road it is on is one-way in the arrow's direction: no oncoming traffic, no U-turns.
explain.trap: 'parcheggio libero' (free car park): parking signs show a 'P'.

sceneParams.caption: One-way arrow, not a car park
